visual.description: Black bar spanning full width with centered promotional text and close button on right.
White nav bar with logo left, 5 nav links center, and a single CTA button right.
Left column holds headline, subtext, CTA button, and trust badges; right column is an overlapping composite image of a laptop mockup and a product photo with no dividing line.
Dark teal background with a large mountain illustration on the left and a right-aligned bullet list of client pain statements.
Light background with centered headline and subtext spanning the full content width.
Three equal-width columns each with an icon and step description on a light background.
Full-width section with a single centered CTA button above a wavy section divider.
Repeating rows alternating between image-left/text-right and text-left/image-right with overlapping illustrated icon badges at corners.
Light background with centered headline and a four-column horizontal grid of website thumbnail cards.
Single-row horizontal ticker showing category labels scrolling across the full width.
Dark teal background with centered headline and a horizontal carousel showing four review cards side by side with left/right navigation arrows.
Left column has headline and an accordion list of service categories; right column is a dark teal panel with descriptive text stacked over a landscape photo.
Left column holds the FAQ section title, description, and CTA button; right column holds a vertical stack of accordion question rows.
Dark background with left text column describing a guide download and right column containing an email input field and download CTA button.
Light background with centered section label and three equal-width article cards each containing an image and title.
A dark teal wavy SVG divider separating the blog section from the template section below.
Dark teal background with centered headline and four equal-width product cards displaying device mockup images of premium templates.
